system.description:
Damage: D3 per 1kg of the thrown item. Cost and weight: na.

Archaic weapons are cruder ranged weapons used in low-tech societies.

Traits

  • Thrown: Adds STR modifier to thrown attacks AND damage; cannot throw more than 1kg per +1DM STR modifier; each additional 1kg deals D3 damage.
  • Low-Tech: Anyone attempting to use this weapon without Ranged (Archaic) incurs an additional -1DM; wind, temperature, moisture, etc. are factors in its efficiency.

Archaic weapons are cruder ranged weapons used in low-tech societies.

Traits

  • Arching: Can be fired in an arching trajectory, decreasing any cover bonus for the target by 1 step.
  • Low-Tech: Anyone attempting to use this weapon without Ranged (Archaic) incurs an additional -1DM; wind, temperature, moisture, etc. are factors in its efficiency.

Archaic weapons are cruder ranged weapons used in low-tech societies.

Traits

  • Shafted: The ammunition is shafted missiles that can transport additional effects, such as poison, minor explosives, or other items as allowed by the referee.
  • Low-Tech: Anyone attempting to use this weapon without Ranged (Archaic) incurs an additional -1DM; wind, temperature, moisture, etc. are factors in its efficiency.

Traits

  • Low-Tech: Anyone attempting to use this weapon without Ranged (Archaic) incurs an additional -1DM; wind, temperature, moisture, etc. are factors in its efficiency.

  • Low-Tech: Anyone attempting to use this weapon without Ranged (Archaic) incurs an additional -1DM; wind, temperature, moisture, etc. are factors in its efficiency.

Traits

  • Slow-Reload: It takes two full rounds to reload this firearm.
  • Unreliable: If this weapon misfires, it takes D3 rounds to reset it to be usable again.
